newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed veteran Meulendyke joins R.H. Wrightson.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed veteran Meulendyke joins R.H. Wrightson.

text.p: Ann-Marie Meulendyke, who worked for 26 years at the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, will join R.H. Wrightson & Associates in early August as an economist, Wrightson said.
Meulendyke will replace Michael Cloherty, who last week left Wrightson after 6-1/2 years to join Credit Suisse First Boston Corp as a money market economist.
Meulendyke is currently employed at Bear, Stearns & Co Inc, where she has been for just over a year.
She will start at Wrightson on August 5.

At the New York Fed, Meulendyke worked in both the research and open market operations departments. She will act as both a Fed watcher and an economic data analyst at Wrightson, according to Wrightson chief economist Louis Crandall.
